description: This file contains unit tests for the Azure-based Orleans Reminders Table, validating its interactions with Azure Storage. It defines the class AzureRemindersTableTests, which inherits from ReminderTableTestsBase, and includes test methods for initialization, reminders range retrieval, parallel upsert operation, and simple reminder functionality.
